g.text: Qwen3-MoE P/D overlap: mapping, repair and A256

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #45515c

g.text: BusyBarn 2 × 4 dies · P: representative prefill MHA + cross-group KV · D: full 7-stage decode chain

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #45515c

g.text: Nine samples per arm: 3 release phases × 3 backend seeds. Lower is faster.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #45515c

g.text: Original uses whole-message service; A256 uses 256 KiB chunks with hop-level C4. Their difference includes both changes.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #45515c

g.text: Mapping and EIR reduce D latency. A256 slightly reduces mean D latency while increasing mean P completion time.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Bar / dot: mean Whiskers: observed min–max across nine samples
